premises.text: Illnesses spread silently for weeks because detection waits for symptoms and relies on slow manual PCR of individuals
premises.evidence_span: it takes weeks to detect illnesses, because many people don't even show symptoms. This means that illnesses are moving silently amongst us

premises.text: Sewage surveillance can measure a whole community with one test and detect symptomatic, asymptomatic, or pre-symptomatic infection at high sensitivity
premises.evidence_span: You measure a whole community with a single test. Even better, you can detect illnesses right from the beginning of infection, if they're symptomatic, asymptomatic, or pre-symptomatic. Best yet, you can detect one sick person in 10,000 people

premises.text: Manual sewage sampling, lab transport, and analysis takes up to a week and costs up to $1,000, so data arrive too late and use is limited to desperate government need
premises.evidence_span: A person has to take a sample from the sewer, drive it to the lab, then analyze it and send the data back. This means the data could take up to a week and cost up to $1,000

premises.text: Plug-and-play automated end-to-end hardware and software installs in buildings and detects multiple pathogens from sewage
premises.evidence_span: Untap Health is providing plug-and-play automated end-to-end hardware and software solution that can be installed into any and every building. Our product can detect up to 12 pathogens

premises.text: Multi-stage hardware automates gold-standard lab workflow: keep dirty filtrate from large volumes, mechatronic RNA extraction, and continuous collective qPCR with same-day data
premises.evidence_span: Our hardware is a multi-stage technology automating the gold standard lab workflow for sewage surveillance. It has multiple patents pending. It consists of three stages

premises.text: Customer dashboard delivers pathogen risk levels and personalized prevention insights for workplaces and nursing homes
premises.evidence_span: see personalized insights, which provide them with their risk levels and ways to prevent outbreak happening

premises.text: Target customers include care homes, offices, factories, schools, cruise ships, and similar buildings needing outbreak prevention
premises.evidence_span: This means that data can go directly to organizations that need it most. Care homes, offices, factories, and so much more

premises.text: Aggregated multi-site data can guide preventative healthcare, insurance, and public health policy beyond single-site monitoring
premises.evidence_span: Those data insights can be used to guide preventative healthcare solutions, insurance policy, public health policy, and so, so much more
